mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( issuer_member_id, category, name, summary, description, image_url, extra_info, target_amount, current_amount, token_price, total_token_quantity, funded_token_quantity, expected_yield, deadline, status ) VALUES ( #{issuerMemberId}, #{category}, #{name}, #{summary}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{extraInfo}, #{targetAmount}, #{currentAmount}, #{tokenPrice}, #{totalTokenQuantity}, #{fundedTokenQuantity}, #{expectedYield}, #{deadline}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, issuer_member_id, category, name, summary, description, image_url, extra_info, target_amount, current_amount, token_price, total_token_quantity, funded_token_quantity, expected_yield, deadline, status, created_at, updated_at FROM products WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, issuer_member_id, category, name, summary, description, image_url, extra_info, target_amount, current_amount, token_price, total_token_quantity, funded_token_quantity, expected_yield, deadline, status, created_at, updated_at FROM products WHERE issuer_member_id = #{issuerMemberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, issuer_member_id, category, name, summary, description, image_url, extra_info, target_amount, current_amount, token_price, total_token_quantity, funded_token_quantity, expected_yield, deadline, status, created_at, updated_at FROM products WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
